# Low Design Office (LowDO)

> Architecture and design-build studio in Austin, Texas and Tema, Ghana. Architects who build, realizing more with less: low-cost materials, low-energy technologies, low-carbon strategies.

Founded by Ryan Bollom and DK Osseo-Asare. Work spans custom residential, ranch and ADU projects in Texas, community and cultural buildings, and open-source building systems. Recognition includes the Architectural League of New York's Emerging Voices (2021), Domus 50 Best Architecture Firms (2020), the Venice Architecture Biennale (2023, 2025), MoMA PS1 YAP finalist (2019), and AIA Austin design awards.

- [ADU Library](https://lowdo.net/adu-library/): accessory dwelling unit designs for Austin
